title: ACCRUE: Continual Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Robot Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.18596v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves robot foundation models (RFMs) beyond their demonstrations, but real-world deployment demands more: learning new tasks efficiently while retaining previously acquired behaviors. Existing continual RL methods on top of VLAs mitigate forgetting but rely on on-policy updates with limited forward transfer, whereas off-policy methods improve single-task sample efficiency without addressing learner persistence across tasks. We propose ACCRUE, a continual off-policy RL framework that carries lightweight actor and critic networks across tasks, allowing each stage to reuse behavioral and value knowledge acquired through prior RL. The inherited critic adapts only on current-task transitions and guides current-task actor learning, while prior behavior is preserved by distilling the actor toward cached targets on a small number of retained episodes. Fixed visual features keep the inherited learner

translated_title: ACCRUE：面向机器人基础模型的持续离策略强化学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）后训练能够使机器人基础模型（RFMs）超越其演示数据的表现，但现实世界的部署提出了更高的要求：在高效学习新任务的同时保留先前习得的行为。现有基于视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）的持续RL方法可以缓解遗忘问题，但依赖于在策略更新，前向迁移能力有限；而离策略方法虽然提高了单任务的样本效率，却没有解决学习器在跨任务间的持续性问题。我们提出ACCRUE，这是一个持续离策略RL框架，它在任务之间携带轻量级的actor和critic网络，使每个阶段都能复用通过先前RL获得的行为知识和价值知识。继承的critic仅在当前任务的转移数据上进行适应，并指导当前任务的actor学习，而先前行为则通过在少量保留的回合数据上向缓存目标蒸馏actor来加以保留。固定的视觉特征使继承的学习器（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ACCRUE是一个持续离策略强化学习框架，通过跨任务继承轻量级actor-critic网络并结合行为蒸馏机制，使机器人基础模型能够在高效学习新任务的同时保留先前习得的技能。
en_tdlr: ACCRUE is a continual off-policy reinforcement learning framework that carries lightweight actor-critic networks across tasks and preserves prior behaviors through distillation, enabling robot foundation models to efficiently learn new tasks while retaining previously acquired skills.
